text:
HMM WHAT'S ALL THE
COMMOTION ON THE
PLANET ARES?

THAT DOES IT! MY
ENLARGER LENS SHOWS
-NO IT CAN'T BE!
BUT IT IS!

ONLY THE MADNESS OF A WARPED
GENIUS COULD CONCEIVE SUCH A
PLAN DIABOLICALLY CLEVER, IT
WOULD DESTROY THE UNIVERSE!
BUT THERE WAS MYSTA, WHOSE
MIND WAS SCHOOLED TO PEACE
AND CULTURE AND FREEDOM-
WHOSE MIND WAS FILLED WITH ALL
KNOWLEDGE, COULD SHE STOP
THE COMING DEBACLE?
